summary: One medium missing-link finding: the additive stable-quotient dependency to QuiverRepresentations Layer 6 was delegated to a partial unreviewed packet and is absent from the built atlas, including as an indirect path. All six active links and four ownership decisions survive the contract checks. The second partner-hosted edge, to Zigzag Layer 2, is integrated.

Immutable URLs and read scopes are in the report; no new whole-library absence claim.

Repeated the target's 73 completeness queries over the current 221-roadmap, 2028-stage base/research catalogue: 116 matching stage records in 52 owners and README matches in 54 owners. Also ran a narrower exact-carrier search (22 owner hits), inspected plausible additional stages and searched current packets/decompositions for exact SPC, matrix-factorization, Gorenstein-projective and stable-module references. Negative screening is not a full proof audit of every matched document.

Read-only build.assemble(require_distances=False) succeeds with 2840 stages and 8007 edges. All six active links and SPC.0 -> Zigzag.2 exist. SPC.0 -> Quiver.6 has no edge or path in the assembled graph with declared requires; its only research host is partial, lacks an accepted review and has no data/links counterpart.

Checked build.py and decompositions.merge_links: only promoted links arrays create reviewed edges; deduplicatedLinks is not imported. A scratch restoration passes check_links (seven links, four overlaps, zero errors/warnings), merges acyclically to 8008 edges, and repeating the merge leaves 8008 distinct edges. The 8118-edge union with declared requires and all 36 research link packets has no reverse path for any of the six current or the proposed edge.

Current packet check_links: six links, four overlaps, 217 historical examined entries, zero errors/warnings. Ran check_redteam, swarm intake check-files on the two deliverables, and git diff --check. No Lean source changed or compiled. The proposed correction was tested only in scratch; no target packet, partner packet, audit or production atlas was edited.

Consequently the built atlas has neither this edge nor an indirect supplier-to-consumer path. The preserved deduplicatedLinks record is provenance, not an integrated dependency.
findings.evidence: SPC Layer 0: 'For a class `P` of objects, define the ideal generated by maps `X → Q → Y` with `P(Q)`.' Quiver Layer 6 says the transpose/duality construction 'is well-defined only up to projectives, through minimal presentations and duality on finite-dimensional modules'. Both quotations are literal, with the latter whitespace-normalized here. At explorer 66c597f569f799c015598af0c71492aeae24d754 the partner research packet has status partial and no review. scripts/build.py loads data/links; scripts/decompositions.py:merge_links iterates only packet.links and requires accepted review. Read-only actual assembly has 2840 stages and 8007 edges, no SPC.0 -> Quiver.6 edge/path, whereas the other delegated SPC.0 -> Zigzag.2 edge is present. The pinned MorphismIdeal quotient is generic and does not make the planned chosen-object factoring-ideal/opposite interface an integrated roadmap dependency.
